messages:
Priya S.: Quick sync - proposing a change to SIEM export retention policy: dev/staging exports retained 90 days, prod exports retained 365 days. Need security + legal signoff before we flip the pipeline.
Alex K.: Sounds reasonable. One question: do we still keep raw payloads in dev for troubleshooting or only scrubbed views?
Priya S.: Intend to keep raw in a temp bucket for 7 days, then archive encrypted for the retention window. For dev we avoid long-term raw archives beyond 90d.
Marcus L.: Heads-up: partners currently rely on wrapped artifacts and CMK unwraps. Shortening prod retention to 365d requires key rotation/migration plan so we don't lose audit trail or break forensics.
Samir P.: For incident response we need an on-demand snapshot flow that freezes retention for specific exports (legal hold). That should be admin-only with JIT KMS unwrap and full audit.
Legal Team: @Priya S. please include a legal-hold workflow in the RFC: triggers, who authorizes, where snapshots live, and release process.
Priya S.: Draft snippet: 
- Trigger: Security incident or legal request
- Action: create hold ticket, snapshot export to hold-bucket, escalate KMS unwrap approval to forensics role
- Release: Legal Team releases hold
Alex K.: RBAC proposal: add `siem_export_reader` role to read scrubbed exports (no decrypt), and `forensics_unwrap` for decrypts. Forensics role requires 2FA + manager approval.
Marcus L.: Agree. Add IAM condition to kms:Decrypt that requires context `project=forensics` and `approval=true`. Immutable audit log entry on every unwrap.
security-bot: Automated note - current SIEM exporter SA has decrypt on CMK `siem-export-key-v1`. Last change: 2025-11-03.
oncall: If we do JIT unwraps, update runbooks - oncall needs emergency bypass path with post-hoc audit, not permanent perms.
Samir P.: Implementation idea: short-lived KMS grants (7d) tied to ticket ID. Workflow: ticket -> approval -> grant. Grant metadata contains ticket id and approver.
Priya S.: Action items: 1) I update RFC with retention matrix + legal-hold flow; 2) Alex opens RBAC PR for `siem_export_reader` and `forensics_unwrap`; 3) Marcus drafts KMS grant workflow; 4) Samir updates incident runbooks.
Alex K.: I'll open PR-7901 with policy samples.
Marcus L.: I'll prototype an orchestration that issues KMS grants and writes audit records to an immutable ledger.
Legal Team: Timeline? We need review within 2 weeks due to an external audit in ~3 weeks.
Priya S.: Two-week review OK. I'll tag reviewers and schedule a review session.
Alex K.: Sample IAM snippet I'll include: 
- Effect: Allow
  Action: kms:Decrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:...:siem-export-key-v1
  Condition:
    StringEquals:
      kms:GrantToken: "ticket-INC-5678"
Samir P.: Also push for masking sensitive PII at export time (hash emails, mask IPs) to reduce unwrap frequency and exposure.
Marcus L.: Masking as configurable transform step in exporter pipeline - default masks with opt-in raw export for approved cases.
Priya S.: OK - I'll file RFC update today and tag Legal + Infra. :thumbsup:
Alex K.: No objections.
Marcus L.: Infra good with this.
Legal Team: We'll review once RFC is posted.
security-bot: Reminder - found 2 KMS grants older than 90 days: G-4433, G-4499. Create cleanup tickets.
Priya S.: Adding cleanup to action list.
Priya S.: Thanks all - will post RFC link and meeting invite when ready.
